queries_run: Arm Holdings market share gaining OR losing 2026 data center server CPU

findings.claim: 20-F 自述：雲端運算市場中 Arm 架構晶片因 CSP 自研晶片與其他 CSP 採用授權客戶晶片而持續拿下份額。
findings.excerpt: Arm-based chips have been gaining market share as CSPs have started to deploy Arm products in their own in-house designed chips used in their data centers, and as other CSPs start to deploy chips designed by Arm licensees.

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因子：x86 與免費開源 RISC-V 為競爭者，許多客戶同時是 RISC-V 支持者，客戶可能改用 RISC-V。
findings.excerpt: Many of our customers are also major supporters of the RISC-V architecture and related technologies. If RISC-V-related technology continues to be developed and market support for RISC-V increases, our customers may choose to utilize this free, open-source architecture instead of our products.

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因子：多家客戶自建 AI 加速器，若工作負載由 CPU 移向加速器，CPU 市場規模與授權費／權利金可能下降。
findings.excerpt: Further, several of our customers are creating their own bespoke accelerators for artificial intelligence (“AI”) workloads that are intended to sit alongside the Arm core. If, over time, more of the workloads move to accelerators away from the CPU, the CPU market size may decrease, resulting in a decrease of our license fees and royalties.

findings.claim: 20-F：Arm 自推 Arm AGI CPU 等量產矽產品，部分授權客戶將面臨與 Arm 直接競爭。
findings.excerpt: Furthermore, many of our customers who have historically licensed our IP may face direct competition from us in certain market segments, which could impact our existing commercial relationships. For example, some of our customers may face direct competition from us in silicon production products, such as with the Arm AGI CPU.

findings.claim: TrendForce 預估 Arm 架構 CPU 2026 年占伺服器 CPU 出貨超過 20%、2027 年約 30%，AMD 2026 年約 27%。
findings.excerpt: capacity at TSMC limiting AMD’s ability to accommodate additional orders, TrendForce estimates that the company’s share of the server CPU market will increase significantly to approximately 27% in 2026. In the Arm-based CPU segment, AWS continues to deploy its internally developed Graviton processors, while demand for NVIDIA’s Grace CPUs continues to expand.

findings.claim: Mercury Research 認為即使 AGI CPU 賣到約 20 億美元，Arm 整體 CPU 市占仍處低個位數。
findings.excerpt: less than two months, the company attained around $2 billion in commitments for its AGI CPU over the next several years, smashing the company's expectations two-fold. But despite this heightened interest, Arm's market share will remain in the low single digits even if it manages to ship $2 billion worth of CPUs in two years, Mercury Research told Tom's Hardware.
